source.primary: Queensland Health and Wellbeing Hip lunge
source.protocol: Stand one foot forward and one back. Lift rear heel, bend front knee over ankle. Raise arms overhead with relaxed shoulders, chest lifted and hips forward. Hold20–30seconds then return/switch.
